'''Christopher Barner-Kowollik''' (born 1973) is a German–Australian materials scientist who is a former [[Australian Research Council]] Laureate Fellow working in macromolecular photochemistry.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=ARC |date=2017-06-05 |title=2017 Laureate Profile: Professor Christopher Barner-Kowollik |url=http://www.arc.gov.au/2017-laureate-profile-professor-christopher-barner-kowollik |access-date=2018-06-29 |website=www.arc.gov.au}}</ref>  He is currently an Alexander-von-Humboldt Professor [https://www.humboldt-foundation.de/en/explore/newsroom/dossier-alexander-von-humboldt-professorship/christopher-barner-kowollik] and Institute [https://ifg.kit.edu Director] at the [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]] (KIT) and a former Deputy Vice-Chancellor and Vice-President (Research) of the [[Queensland University of Technology]] (QUT). He holds a fractional appointment as Distinguished Professor within the School of Chemistry and Physics at the QUT in Brisbane.[https://www.qut.edu.au/about/our-people/academic-profiles/christopher.barnerkowollik] From 2017 to 2024 he was editor-in-chief of the [[Royal Society of Chemistry|Royal Society of Chemistry (RSC)]] journal ''[[Polymer Chemistry (journal)|Polymer Chemistry]]'',<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/polymer-chemistry/editorial-board-members/|title=Polymer Chemistry editorial board members|last=Chemistry|first=Royal Society of|date=2016-02-23|website=www.rsc.org|access-date=2018-07-01}}</ref> and is an editor for the RSC's journal ''[[Chemical Science (journal)|Chemical Science]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chemical Science journal editorial board members |url=https://www.rsc.org/journals-books-databases/about-journals/chemical-science/editorial-board-members/ |access-date=2024-07-05 |website=Royal Society of Chemistry |language=en-GB}}</ref> He is a principal investigator within the Soft Matter Materials Laboratory at QUT.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://staff.qut.edu.au/staff/barnerko/|title=QUT {{!}} Staff Profiles {{!}} Christopher Barner-Kowollik|last=Christopher|first=Barner-Kowollik|website=staff.qut.edu.au|access-date=2018-07-01}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
After his undergraduate studies of [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Konstanz|Universities of Constance]] and [[University of Göttingen|Goettingen]] (Germany), Christopher Barner-Kowollik earned his PhD in physical chemistry ([[Dr. rer. nat.]]) from the University of Goettingen in 1999.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Free-Radical Bulk Copolymerization Kinetics of Acrylate and Methacrylate Monomers Studied by Pulsed Laser Techniques by Christopher Barner-Kowollik {{!}} 9783897127050 {{!}} Get Textbooks {{!}} New Textbooks {{!}} Used Textbooks {{!}} College Textbooks - GetTextbooks.co.in |url=https://www.gettextbooks.co.in/isbn/9783897127050/ |access-date=2024-10-14 |website=www.gettextbooks.co.in}}</ref> Following postdoctoral research with Tom Davis at the [[University of New South Wales]], he held academic positions at the Centre for Advanced Macromolecular Design (CAMD), and was appointed Full Professor of Polymer Chemistry in 2006 at the same institution.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Barner-Kowollik |first=Christopher |title=Christopher Barner-Kowollik |url=https://research.qut.edu.au/cms/people/christopher-barner-kowollik/ |access-date=2024-10-15 |website=Centre for Materials Science |language=en-AU}}</ref> In 2008, he moved back to Germany, where he became the Chair of Macromolecular Chemistry at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT). There he was the founding director of the Collaborative Research Centre SFB 1176 'Molecular Structuring of Soft Matter' established by the German Research Council (DFG).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sfb1176.de|title=KIT - SFB 1176 - Startpage|last=Barner|first=Leonie|date=2018-06-25|website=www.sfb1176.de|language=en-gb|access-date=2018-07-06}}</ref> He is a founding PI and thrust speaker in the DFG Excellence Cluster 3D Matter Made to Order.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Office|first=Cluster|date=2020-07-29|title=3D Matter Made to Order (3DMM2O) - The Cluster - People - Principal Investigators|url=https://www.3dmattermadetoorder.kit.edu/principal_investigators_113.php|access-date=2021-09-03|website=www.3dmattermadetoorder.kit.edu|language=en-gb}}</ref> 

Barner-Kowollik relocated in 2017 to the [[Queensland University of Technology]] (QUT), where he was awarded an Australian Laureate Fellowship and appointed Director of QUT's Soft Matter Materials Laboratory. He was an associate group leader at the KIT's Institute of Nanotechnology and the Institute of Polymer Chemistry and Chemical Technology, after heading a full research group at the KIT until 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://staff.qut.edu.au/staff/barnerko/|title=QUT {{!}} Staff Profiles {{!}} Christopher Barner-Kowollik|last=Christopher|first=Barner-Kowollik|website=staff.qut.edu.au|language=en|access-date=2018-07-06}}</ref> In December 2019 Barner-Kowollik was appointed Deputy Vice-Chancellor Research and Vice-President of QUT,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.qut.edu.au/news?id=154509|title=QUT appoints new DVCs for research and education|last=Technology (QUT)|first=Queensland University of|website=QUT|language=en|access-date=2019-12-18}}</ref> from September 2022 to January 2025 he additionally held the role of Senior Deputy Vice Chancellor and Vice-President.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Technology (QUT) |first=Queensland University of |title=Executive team |url=https://www.qut.edu.au/about/our-people/executive-team |access-date=2023-01-25 |website=QUT |language=en}}</ref> He is currently an Alexander-von-Humboldt Professor and Institute Director at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT).  

== Research ==
Barner-Kowollik's research was initially in the field of [[polymer chemistry]] and polymer reaction kinetics.<ref>{{Cite book|last=Kowollik, Christopher.|title=Free radical bulk copolymerization kinetics of acrylate and methacrylate monomers studied by pulsed laser techniques|date=1999|publisher=Cuvillier|isbn=3-89712-705-9|location=Göttingen|oclc=45539621}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Feldermann |first1=Achim |last2=Coote |first2=Michelle L. |last3=Stenzel |first3=Martina H. |last4=Davis |first4=Thomas P. |last5=Barner-Kowollik |first5=Christopher |date=2004-12-01 |title=Consistent Experimental and Theoretical Evidence for Long-Lived Intermediate Radicals in Living Free Radical Polymerization |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/ja046292b |journal=Journal of the American Chemical Society |language=en |volume=126 |issue=48 |pages=15915–15923 |doi=10.1021/ja046292b |pmid=15571417 |bibcode=2004JAChS.12615915F |issn=0002-7863|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Over the course of his career, his research has fused polymer chemistry with [[Organic chemistry|organic]] and [[photochemistry]]. These research areas include the development of wavelength-[[Orthogonality|orthogonal]], -[[Synergy|synergistic]], -[[Cooperative (disambiguation)|cooperative]] and -[[Antagonist (disambiguation)|antagonistic]] reactions,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Frisch|first1=Hendrik|last2=Marschner|first2=David E.|last3=Goldmann|first3=Anja S.|last4=Barner-Kowollik|first4=Christopher|date=2018|title=Wavelength-Gated Dynamic Covalent Chemistry|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|language=en|volume=57|issue=8|pages=2036–2045|doi=10.1002/anie.201709991|pmid=29064612 |issn=1521-3773|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Kalayci|first1=Kubra|last2=Frisch|first2=Hendrik|last3=Truong|first3=Vinh X.|last4=Barner-Kowollik|first4=Christopher|date=2020-08-21|title=Green light triggered [2+2] cycloaddition of halochromic styrylquinoxaline—controlling photoreactivity by pH|journal=Nature Communications|language=en|volume=11|issue=1|page=4193|doi=10.1038/s41467-020-18057-9|doi-access=free|pmid=32826921 | pmc=7443129|bibcode=2020NatCo..11.4193K |issn=2041-1723}}</ref> and their photophysical understanding.<ref>{{Cite journal|date=2020-12-15|title=A holistic approach for anthracene photochemistry kinetics|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1385894720323871|journal=Chemical Engineering Journal|language=en|volume=402|article-number=126259|doi=10.1016/j.cej.2020.126259|issn=1385-8947|last1=Kislyak |first1=Anastasia |last2=Kodura |first2=Daniel |last3=Frisch |first3=Hendrik |last4=Feist |first4=Florian |last5=Van Steenberge |first5=Paul H.M. |last6=Barner-Kowollik |first6=Christopher |last7=d'Hooge |first7=Dagmar R. |bibcode=2020ChEnJ.40226259K |s2cid=225028511 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Kislyak|first1=Anastasia|last2=Frisch|first2=Hendrik|last3=Gernhardt|first3=Marvin|last4=Steenberge|first4=Paul H.
